model_name: ManoFit Behavioral & Stress Risk Predictive Model
known_limitations: Model operates exclusively on pseudonymized rolling aggregations; no direct clinical diagnoses.
Subject to monthly recalibration by Welfare Clinical Review Board.
Zero cross-linkage to disciplinary or performance evaluation records.

Phase 1 training labels are rule-based synthetic stand-ins, not clinical outcomes. Because those labels are derived from the same features the model reads, reported training metrics are near-perfect by construction and MUST NOT be read as real-world accuracy. Genuine performance is unknown until the Phase 2 clinical-review loop supplies reviewed labels.
Trained on synthetic bootstrap data only; no real personnel records have been seen by this version.
